abstractEnglish: We prove Brennan's conjecture: if a simply connected plane domain admits a conformal bijection φ onto the unit disk, then $`|\varphi'|^s`$ is area-integrable for every $`4/3\lt s\lt 4`$. We also prove the sharp inverse-square integral-means exponent $`B_{\mathcal S}(-2)=1`$ for the normalized schlicht class $`\mathcal S`$.
